use forge::prelude::*;
use uuid::Uuid;

#[forge_enum]
pub enum UserRole {
    Admin,
    Member,
    Guest,
}

#[forge::model]
pub struct User {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub email: String,
    pub display_name: Option<String>,
    pub role: UserRole,
    pub created_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UserSummary {
    pub id: Uuid,
    pub email: String,
    pub role: UserRole,
}

#[forge::query(auth = "none", tables("users"))]
pub async fn list_users(ctx: &QueryContext) -> Result<Vec<User>> {
    Ok(vec![])
}

#[forge::query(auth = "none", tables("users"))]
pub async fn get_user(ctx: &QueryContext, id: Uuid) -> Result<Option<UserSummary>> {
    Ok(None)
}
